question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the idiom used in the given sentence.**

The new production targets have stirred up a hornet's nest.
solution:
The correct answer is **"To raise controversy."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"stir up a hornet's nest" **means to create a situation that causes a lot of trouble or controversy. (ऐसी स्थिति पैदा करना जिससे बहुत परेशानी या विवाद हो) 

 
 
• **Example:** *This Lonnie Norton was asking a lot of questions and **stirring up a hornet's nest**__ around town.*
 
 
 
• The phrase **"hornet's nest"** refers to a group of angry or agitated people, like a swarm of hornets.
 
• In this sentence, the production targets have caused a lot of controversy or upset among people.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
